chunks: Yūnus, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: A group of people jointly purchased a slave-girl, then they trusted one of themselves and placed the slave-girl with him, and he had intercourse with her.

He said: "He is to be flogged with the hadd, and it is reduced from him in proportion to the share he has in her. The slave-girl is to be appraised, and he must pay her price to the partners. If the value on the day he had intercourse with her was less than what she was purchased for, then he is made liable for the greater price, because he has corrupted her for his partners. And if the value on the day he had intercourse with her was greater than what she was purchased for, he is made liable for the greater amount because of his having rendered her corrupted."

key_terms.أَفْسَدَ: he caused damage or corruption affecting the rights of others
key_terms.الشُّرَكَاءِ: the co-owners or partners who share ownership
key_terms.الْحَدَّ: the hadd punishment prescribed by sacred law
key_terms.تُقَوَّمُ: she is to be appraised for monetary valuation
key_terms.ثَمَنَهَا: her price or compensable monetary value
key_terms.جَارِيَةٍ: a female slave owned as property in the legal context of the report
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged as a prescribed corporal punishment
key_terms.يُدْرَأُ: it is averted or reduced from him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one co-owner has intercourse with a jointly owned slave-girl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a jointly owned slave-girl when one partner has intercourse with her unlawfully. It states that the hadd is applied proportionally in light of his ownership share, and that he must compensate the other partners based on her appraised value or the higher relevant price because he caused loss to their shared property rights.
